note: The API KEYRING registry. Each entry tells keys.js (a) where a key of that provider goes on an outgoing request - a header or a query parameter, its name, an optional scheme, and any static headers the provider demands - and (b) how to probe the key so the KEYRING panel can answer 'is this key alive?' without any integration code existing yet. `browser` records what a browser fetch from THIS generator's origin actually did (measured 2026-09-17, dummy keys): direct = the provider answered the browser (401/400 = a real HTTP answer, so CORS is open); proxy = the fetch was refused by CORS and a relay (root.superFetch, the super-fetch-plugin) is needed. Integration code should read `mode`: when it is 'proxy', call keyring.request() and it will route through the relay by itself. Nothing here is a secret; keys live only in this device's IndexedDB (kv lia_settings / api_keys).

providers.label: ElevenLabs
providers.testNote: the account check needs a key created with the 'user read' permission, and listing voices needs 'voices read'. A key without them still SPEAKS (text_to_speech is a separate permission) - that is why the shipped voice palette exists.
providers.use: her spoken voice (text-to-speech), speech-to-text, and the conversational agents

providers.label: Hugging Face
providers.use: inference API: any hosted text, vision, or embedding model - Whisper for his microphone

providers.label: Anthropic
providers.use: Claude models - the browser call only works with the dangerous-direct-browser-access header, which is already declared above

providers.label: Google AI (Gemini)
providers.use: Gemini text, vision, and the gemini-embedding models the LOREPACK FACTORY mints with. This key rides in the URL, so treat any request log as a secret

providers.label: Google Drive (OAuth)
providers.hint: OAuth tokens - connected from the SYNC panel, never pasted
providers.use: private cloud sync of the archive (SYNC send/receive). Scope is drive.file: only the one file the terminal creates itself

providers.label: Stability AI
providers.use: image generation and upscaling, as an alternative to the built-in forge

providers.label: Replicate
providers.use: hosted models of every kind. Replicate refuses browser-origin calls, so requests go through the relay (super-fetch-plugin)

providers.label: Models Lab
providers.use: image and video generation. No probe is wired (its account endpoint answers before it reads a key), so the panel will hold this key without checking it

providers.label: Groq
providers.use: Groq chat (OpenAI-compatible API) - the /groq lane, her fastest brain

providers.label: PRIAPOS Authority (GateKeeper)
providers.hint: the Authority's API key (READ_ONLY is enough for the door)
providers.use: PRIAPOS, the first door: the key the INSPECT road sends as X-API-Key when a gk_ pass is presented. The module tries a direct browser call first and the relay itself if the Authority refuses the origin. No probe is wired (the Authority's URL is his own server, set with /gatekeeper authority) - /gatekeeper keytest proves the key instead

providers.label: OpenL (RapidAPI)
providers.hint: RapidAPI key (X-RapidAPI-Key) - pasted in the panel, never in the input line
providers.use: the dead-languages road: OpenL AI translation (171 languages, Ancient Greek as grc) via RapidAPI - the first road /xlate tries when this key is held, MyMemory when it is not
